Bumetanide is a sulfonamide-type loop diuretic, with a 3-(aminosulfonyl)-5-butylamino-4-phenoxybenzoic acid structure. In tablet form for retail dosage it falls in heading 3004. Subheading 3004.90 covers other medicaments, and the 10-digit statistical suffix is 3004.90.9290 for "other" medicaments in dosage form.

Bumetanide has appeared in CBP rulings under 3004.90.9255 or 3004.90.9290. The 3004.90.92 group covers "Other," and its suffixes include 3004.90.9210 (diuretics?), 3004.90.9215 (antiasthmatics), and others. I recall that 3004.90.9250 or 3004.90.9255 is for "other: diuretics". My best recollection is that statistical suffixes under 3004.90.92 include 3004.90.9205 (antidiabetic?), 3004.90.9210 (analgesics), and 3004.90.9215 (antidepressants), with 3004.90.9255 possibly for cardiovascular or hypertension drugs, so I'm not certain a diuretic-specific suffix exists. The generic "other" at 3004.90.9290 is the safest choice.
